description: Arbitrum One fee reference. A static snapshot captured 2026-11-14, no input: the two-dimensional fee model (the L2 execution floor at 0.1 gwei, the adaptive parent-chain calldata fee priced by Brotli-compressed size), the floor-price transfer scenario computed at the floor, and the observed 2026 typical transfer range, the capture date printed on every card. Price: $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.
name: arbitrum-fee-snapshot
